title: 第13章 地下赌局第14章 小赢几把
content_zh:
夜幕降临。
青龙河营地除了偶尔响起几声虫鸣，整个营地一片死寂。
咚咚咚。
六十三号石屋门口，一名青衫男子，轻轻敲了敲房门。
房门打开，二十岁左右的青年，半边脸颊漆黑，对着眼前男子道：“汪师兄，来了。”
“嗯，时间差不多了，我们走吧。”汪庆中点点头。
“好。”韩林锁上房门，跟着汪庆中沿着小路向前走去。
片刻后，两人来到另外一座，悬挂着十八号木牌的石屋前。
汪庆中有节奏的敲了敲房门，然后静静等待，数个呼吸后，房门打开，一个身材消瘦的青年，微显惊讶道：“汪师兄？”
“呵呵，刘师弟，我给你带新人来了，你还不感谢我。”
“新人？”刘建伸头出去一看，这才看到站在旁边的韩林，“这不是那……韩林嘛，你确定他能玩？”
“要知道，我们这里玩的可不小，一局最低也是十点积分！”
意思是，担心韩林没钱。
汪庆中呵呵一笑：“放心好了，我既然带他过来，那就一定能玩的！”
“那行啊！”
刘建眼睛一亮，“汪师兄，韩师弟，快请进来吧！”
韩林闻言，连忙跟着汪庆中一起，走了进去。
等进屋一看，他却发现，里面也就刘建一个人。
不由得满脸疑惑。
刘建关上房门，微微一笑，掀开墙角地面的一个箩筐，露出一个洞口来，隐隐间，还有光亮从洞口照出。

韩林这才明白，原来里面别有洞天。
刘建带着两人钻进洞口，滑到底，便见一条地下通道。
通道上面镶嵌着月光石，不是很亮，但照明没有问题。
“这边。”
刘建招呼一声，沿着通道向前，来到尽头时轻轻转动一下墙壁上一盏油灯，顿时旁边打开一扇暗门。
一个巨大的空间，映入韩林眼帘。
空间中央，摆放着一张大方桌，有一大群人正围在一起，嘴里呼喊着。
“大大大！”
“小小小！”
乌烟瘴气，跟世俗的赌坊没什么区别。
随着韩林和汪庆中出现，房间顿时寂静一片，所有人都朝他们看了过来。
韩林惊讶地发现，那个赵锐凌，竟然也在其中。
而且通过通天眼，他还发现这群参与赌博之人，全都打通了两条完整气脉，就连第三条也显现了出来。
很明显，这些人最低也是练气二层，甚至有几位，马上就要三层了。
“大家不用在意，继续玩儿就是，这位是韩林师弟，大家想必都认识，我带他来，陪你们玩玩。”
刘建微微一笑，解释着说道。
听到此话，众人一阵愕然，不过既然是刘建带进来的，他们也没话说。毕竟这个赌场，是刘建做主。
倒是那赵锐凌，暗暗皱了皱眉头，开始盘算起利滚利之下，韩林欠了自己多少积分，可别全部输在这里了。
虽然，他打算收韩林为长工，但收之前，韩林身上的油水，还是要刮一刮的。
喧声再起，刘建对韩林道：“韩师弟，你自己去玩吧，我还要到外面守着，万一一会儿还有人过来，也好开门。”
content_en:
Night falls.
Except for the occasional chirping of insects in Qinglong River Camp, the entire camp was completely silent.
Boom, boom, boom.
At the door of Stone House No. 63, a man in a green shirt knocked gently on the door.
The door opened, and a young man in his twenties, half of his face darkened, said to the man in front of him: "Senior Brother Wang, here he comes."
"Well, it's almost time, let's go." Wang Qingzhong nodded.
"Okay." Han Lin locked the door and followed Wang Qingzhong along the path.
After a while, the two came to another stone house with the number 18 wooden sign hanging on it.
Wang Qingzhong knocked on the door rhythmically, and then waited quietly. After a few breaths, the door opened, and a thin young man said with slight surprise: "Senior Brother Wang?"
"Haha, Junior Brother Liu, I brought you a new person, and you still don't thank me."
"Newcomer?" Liu Jian stretched his head out to take a look, and then saw Han Lin standing next to him, "Isn't this... Han Lin, are you sure he can play?"
"You know, we are here to play a big game, the minimum in a round is ten points!"
This means that he is worried that Han Lin will have no money.
Wang Qingzhong chuckled: "Don't worry, since I brought him here, he will definitely be able to play!"
"That's okay!"
Liu Jian's eyes lit up, "Senior Brother Wang, Junior Brother Han, please come in quickly!"
Upon hearing this, Han Lin quickly followed Wang Qingzhong and walked in.
When he entered the room, he found that Liu Jian was the only one inside.
He couldn't help but look puzzled.
Liu Jian closed the door, smiled slightly, and opened a basket on the ground in the corner, revealing a hole. There was faint light shining from the hole.
Only then did Han Lin realize that there was a cave inside.
Liu Jian led the two of them into the cave entrance, slid to the bottom, and saw an underground passage.
The passage is inlaid with moonstone, which is not very bright, but there is no problem with lighting.
"This way."
Liu Jian said hello and walked forward along the passage. When he reached the end, he gently turned an oil lamp on the wall, and a secret door opened next to it.
A huge space caught Han Lin's eyes.
In the center of the space, there was a large square table, and a large group of people were gathered around, shouting.
"Big big!"
"Little little little!"
The smoky atmosphere is no different from a secular gambling house.
As Han Lin and Wang Qingzhong appeared, the room suddenly became silent, and everyone looked towards them.
Han Lin was surprised to find that Zhao Ruiling was among them.
Moreover, through the Sky Eye, he also discovered that these people participating in gambling all had two complete Qi meridians opened, and even the third one was revealed.
It was obvious that these people were at least the second level of Qi training, and there were even a few who were about to reach the third level.
"Don't worry, everyone, just keep playing. This is Junior Brother Han Lin. Everyone must know him. I will bring him here to play with you."
Liu Jian smiled slightly and explained.
Everyone was stunned when they heard this, but since it was Liu Jian who brought him in, they had nothing to say. After all, Liu Jian is in charge of this casino.
Zhao Ruiling, on the other hand, frowned secretly and began to calculate how many points Han Lin owed him under the compound interest rate. Don't lose them all here.
Although he plans to take Han Lin on as a permanent employee, Han Lin still needs to be wiped off before taking him on.
When the noise started again, Liu Jian said to Han Lin: "Junior Brother Han, you can go and play by yourself. I have to stay outside to open the door in case someone comes over soon."
